claims.claim: The amber garden trial found change in recall.
claims.supporting_quote: The amber garden trial found change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

claims.claim: The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall.
claims.supporting_quote: The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

synthesis: The amber garden trial found change in recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall (Vale, 2024).

sources.amber: The amber garden trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
sources.ivory: The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
